San José 的过去不只有科技园区。让孩子沿着旧街景找一扇商店门，或在农场公: San José’s past reaches beyond technology campuses. Finding an old shopfront or noticing fruit trees and a large barn can turn local history into a small discovery. These destinations have separate entrances and parking; choose one for a first visit.
方案一：History Park，周末下午看建筑: Option 1: History Park on a weekend afternoon
导航到 635 Phelan Avenue。官方 2026 时段为园区每日 9:: Navigate to 635 Phelan Avenue. The published 2026 hours are 9 am–4 pm daily for the grounds and noon–3:45 pm on weekends for historic buildings. The weekend trolley lists noon for the first ride and 3:15 pm for the last, subject to changes. Morning access to the grounds does not mean the buildings are open; check trolley operation before counting on a ride.
建议节奏：先用半小时看看街景，再选一两座当天开放的建筑，最后留时间坐下吃自带点心: Suggested pace: spend half an hour looking at the streets, choose one or two open buildings, then take a snack break. Allow roughly 1.5–2.5 hours.
观察任务：找一种旧交通工具、一块商店招牌和一个与现在不同的生活用品。先让孩子描述: Observation game: find an old means of transport, a shop sign, and an everyday object unlike one used today. Let children describe what they see before reading the interpretation.
费用核对：特殊活动可能有门票或调整开放；停车、食物与活动费用单独确认，不把整个: Cost check: special events may charge admission or change opening hours. Check parking, food, and activity costs separately; do not treat all of Kelley Park as one uniformly free attraction.
方案二：Emma Prusch，把重点放在游乐与野餐: Option 2: Emma Prusch for play and a picnic
公园在 647 S. King Road，市府列出开放时间为 8:30 至日落，: The park is at 647 S. King Road, with published hours of 8:30 am to sunset. It has an inclusive farm-themed playground, toddler play areas, and lawns. Begin at the playground, explore open farm areas, and bring an easy-to-clear lunch; multiple stops are unnecessary.
